description: This file implements the Windows-specific part of a file stream context for asynchronous I/O operations within the Chromium net namespace, including methods for reading, writing, seeking, and handling IO completion events.

classes.name: FileStream::Context
classes.description: Handles asynchronous file I/O operations on Windows, including reading, writing, seeking, and IO completion handling within the Chromium network stack.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Initiates an asynchronous read operation on the file.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Performs a write operation on the file, either synchronously or asynchronously.

methods.name: SeekFileImpl
methods.description: Seeks to a specified offset within the file.

methods.name: OnFileOpened
methods.description: Registers the file handle with the IO thread for asynchronous operations.

methods.name: IOCompletionIsPending
methods.description: Marks an IO operation as pending and stores the callback.

methods.name: OnIOCompleted
methods.description: Handles completion of an IO operation, updating state and invoking callbacks.

methods.name: InvokeUserCallback
methods.description: Calls the user-provided callback after IO completion.

methods.name: DeleteOrphanedContext
methods.description: Cleans up the context if it is orphaned.

methods.name: ReadAsync
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous read using Windows API and posts the result back to the main thread.

methods.name: ReadAsyncResult
methods.description: Processes the result of the asynchronous read operation.
